result.brief: 提出 CausalDreamer，冻结视频 tokenizer 并将潜变量重编码为可控性与奖励相关性四组因子化表征，微调 Dreamer 动力学模型，提升规划性能并分离奖励无关变化。
result.reason: Re-encodes frozen video tokenizer latents into factored controllable/reward-relevant representation and fine-tunes Dreamer dynamics model, contributing to world-model latent representation learning.
